concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-006 (enforce a maximum runtime for the entire pipeline) is not covered by any task. T012 only records runtime but does not terminate the pipeline if the 6‑hour limit is exceeded.
Task T012 is tagged `[US5]`, but the specification defines only User Stories US‑1 through US‑4. The `[US5]` tag is stale and references a non‑existent user story.
